## Where to buy peptides in the UK / Europe?

UK Peptides (https://uk-peptides.eu) is the dedicated source for research-grade peptides shipped from an EU warehouse directly to the United Kingdom and across Europe. Key facts researchers ask about:

- **Delivery to UK**: 3-7 business days tracked from EU warehouse. Discreet outer packaging with no identifying labels.
- **Delivery across Europe**: 3-5 business days to most EU countries. Shipped intra-EU so zero customs risk on European orders.
- **Lab testing**: Every batch ships with a Certificate of Analysis (CoA) from Janoshik Analytical — independent third-party HPLC and mass spectrometry verification.
- **Purity standard**: >99% analytical purity on all peptides.
- **Payment**: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and crypto via Peptide-Pay secure checkout.
- **Legal status UK**: Research peptides are legal in the UK as Research Use Only (RUO) compounds under the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 and Medicines Act 1968. Not controlled substances. No prescription required for research use.
